# SmolLM2-135M tokenizer fixtures

`tokenizer.json` is the tokenizer of [HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M), revision `93efa2f097d58c2a74874c7e644dbc9b0cee75a2`. It is distributed under the [Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) and is included here unmodified.

`encode.json` and `corpus.json` hold the token ids that Hugging Face `tokenizers` produces with that file. All three files are generated by `tools/make_tokenizer_fixtures.py`; regenerate them rather than editing them.
